text:
167
Hochwohlgebohrner Herr
Hochzuverehrender Herr Krieges und Forst Raths
In dem Augenblicke, wo Sr Durchlaucht der
Fürst mit dem alten Herrn in die Kirche
fahren befehlen Sie mir nach Euer Hochwohl¬
gebohren, unter Höchst Ihrer Empfehlung
anliegenden Brief zu senden. Höchstdiesel¬
ben würden gerne selbst geschrieben, ha¬
ben, wenn nicht schon in einer Stunde die
Ordonanz abgiengen.
der alte Fürst befinden sich für Ihr Alten
sehr wohl, und zeigen ausnehmend vieles
Attachement für meinen gnädigsten
Herren. Ich wünsche vom Herzen, daß Euer
Hochwohlgebohren sich recht wohl befinden
mögten, empfehle mich zu fernern
Gewogenheit und habe die Ehre in voll¬
kommenster Verehrung zu beharren:
Euer Hochwohlgebohren,
Öhringen den 7ten Juli
1805.
unterthäniger Diener
A: Hahn
die Rükkunft nach Breslau
ist ohnfehlbar d 25ten bestimmt!

translation.en:
167

Right Honourable Sir, Highly Honoured Sir, Councillor of War and Forests: At the very moment when His Serene Highness the Prince is about to drive to church with the old gentleman, he commands me to send the enclosed letter to Your Right Honourable, with His most gracious regards. He would gladly have written himself, had the courier not been departing within the hour already.

The old Prince is very well for his age, and shows exceedingly great attachment to my most gracious Lord. I wish from my heart that Your

Right Honourable may find yourself in the best of health; I commend myself to your continued favour and have the honour to remain, in most perfect reverence, Your Right Honourable's. Öhringen, the 7th of July 1805.

humble and obedient servant A: Hahn. The return to Wrocław is fixed without fail for the 25th!

Right Honourable Sir, Highly Honoured Sir, Councillor of War and Forests: At the very moment when His Serene Highness the Prince is about to drive to church with the old gentleman, he commands me to send the enclosed letter to Your Right Honourable, with His most gracious regards. He would gladly have written himself, had the courier not been departing within the hour already.

The old Prince is very well for his age, and shows exceedingly great attachment to my most gracious Lord. I wish from my heart that Your

Right Honourable may find yourself in the best of health; I commend myself to your continued favour and have the honour to remain, in most perfect reverence, Your Right Honourable's. Öhringen, the 7th of July 1805.

humble and obedient servant A: Hahn. The return to Wrocław is fixed without fail for the 25th!
summary_en: Hahn writes that, on the orders of the Prince, who is just then driving to church with the old gentleman, he is sending an enclosed letter together with the Prince's compliments to Triebenfeld. The Prince would gladly have written himself, he says, but the orderly leaves within the hour. He reports that the old Prince is very well for his age and shows much attachment to Hahn's master, and that the return to Wrocław has been fixed, without fail, for the 25th.
summary_de: Hahn übersendet auf Befehl des Fürsten, der eben mit dem alten Herrn zur Kirche fährt, einen beiliegenden Brief mit dessen Empfehlung an Triebenfeld. Der Fürst hätte gern selbst geschrieben, doch die Ordonanz gehe schon in einer Stunde ab. Der alte Fürst sei für sein Alter sehr wohl und zeige viel Attachement für Hahns Herrn. Die Rückkunft nach Wrocław sei unfehlbar auf den 25. bestimmt.

reading.notes: A. Hahn, who serves the Prince ("meinen gnädigsten Herren"), writes from Öhringen to Krieges und Forst Rath von Triebenfeld. He is covering an enclosed letter. The Prince was about to drive to church with "dem alten Herrn" and told Hahn to send it with his regards. He would have written himself, but the courier (Ordonanz) leaves within the hour. The old Prince is very well for his age and shows great attachment to Hahn's master. Postscript: the return to Breslau is fixed for the 25th. Nothing about Trąbczyn. The text is sound. Nothing needs a provable correction.
